LOC_TRAINING_DESC: Training yard with brick and steel modules, fire bay, and practice loader.
LOC_DOCK_DESC: Coastal cargo terminal: concrete depots, timber piers, gantry crane, and fuel tanks.
LOC_QUARRY_DESC: Ochre canyon quarry with timber viaduct, crusher tower, and rockfall barricades.
LOC_CRYO_DESC: Arctic outpost featuring glass galleries, twin lab towers, and backup generator wing.
MISSION_TUTORIAL_BRIEF: Learn movement, wall breaching, steel cutting, seismic charges, fire suppression, bridging, and driving.
MISSION_1_BRIEF: Breach the dock warehouse walls, collect 3 Blackbox Telemetry Cores, and reach the barge. Pulling the third core triggers a 45s alarm!
MISSION_2_BRIEF: Cut the steel struts under the upper container to form a bridge. Disable 4 Security Relays with the Burlak-2 Loader and reach the boat in 55s.
MISSION_3_BRIEF: Collapse the timber viaduct and smash rock rubble with the Krot-T Crawler. Recover 4 Seismic Sensors before the landslide (65s timer).
MISSION_4_BRIEF: Slice steel shutters, span the broken skybridge, extinguish fires, and carry 5 Cryo-Data Drives to the helipad in 75 seconds.
SANDBOX_DESC_BANNER: No timer or alarm. Unlimited tools and all vehicles ready.
TOOL_HAMMER_DESC: Impact Breacher: shatters brick, wood, glass, and concrete.
TOOL_LANCE_DESC: Thermal Lance: cuts steel girders and ignites wood or fuel.
TOOL_CHARGE_DESC: Seismic Charge: sticky explosive with radial blast wave.
TOOL_FOAM_DESC: Foam Extinguisher: puts out fires and suppresses smoke.
TOOL_BRIDGE_DESC: Bridge Gun: deploys sturdy composite walkways and ramps.
TOOL_GRAB_DESC: Kinetic Grab: lift, carry, rotate, and throw crates or debris.
TUT_STEP_1: Step 1/8: Look around on the right side and walk to the waypoint.
TUT_STEP_2: Step 2/8: Equip Strike-M Breacher and smash through the brick wall.
TUT_STEP_3: Step 3/8: Equip Arc-7 Thermal Lance and slice through the steel gate.
TUT_STEP_4: Step 4/8: Toss an Impulse Seismic Charge at the concrete pillar and tap DETONATE.
TUT_STEP_5: Step 5/8: Extinguish the burning timber stack with Cryo-Foam.
TUT_STEP_6: Step 6/8: Build a bridge across the trench using Span-X.
TUT_STEP_7: Step 7/8: Enter the Burlak-2 Loader and drive forward (or exit again).
TUT_STEP_8: Step 8/8: Pick up the training beacon and enter the green extraction zone!
TUT_COMPLETE_BANNER: Training complete! Ready for Campaign ops.
BENCH_DESC: Automated 4-phase run: flythrough, local breaches, major blast, and pillar collapse.
